name: Irina Volkov
bio:
Irina's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially studying art restoration in St. Petersburg, she developed a keen eye for detail and an appreciation for the meticulous process of preserving historical artifacts. A chance encounter with a racing team during a university project sparked her fascination with the high-octane world of motorsport and the intricate paint schemes of racing cars. Leaving art restoration she transferred her skills to motorsport. 

Joining JOTA Sport, Irina quickly established herself as a competent paint shop specialist. She possesses a unique ability to blend artistic flair with technical precision, ensuring that every car leaving her shop not only looks stunning but also meets the demanding aerodynamic requirements of competitive racing. Irina is known for her innovative approach to paint application, experimenting with new techniques and materials to push the boundaries of visual performance on the track. Her unwavering commitment to perfection and her visionary perspective have made her an invaluable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often tied back in a practical ponytail during work, with a few strands escaping to frame her face.
physical.description: Irina is of average height with a focused, intense gaze that reflects her dedication to her craft.

quirks: Always listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models on her workbench.
Insists on using only natural light when mixing custom paint colors, regardless of the time of day.
